an10.18:2.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an10.18:2.6: ‘sīlavā vatāyaṃ bhikkhu hoti pātimokkha saṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesū’ti. therāpi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi bhikkhu …pe… navāpi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:2.7: tassa therānukampitassa … majjhimānukampitassa … navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu bahussuto hoti …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an10.18:3.2: ‘bahussuto vatāyaṃ bhikkhu sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā …pe… sātthā, sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti. tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā’ti. therāpi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi bhikkhu …pe… navāpi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:3.3: tassa therānukampitassa … majjhimānukampitassa … navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu,no parihāni.
an10.18:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an10.18:4.2: ‘kalyāṇamitto vatāyaṃ bhikkhu kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko’ti therāpi naṃ vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi bhikkhu …pe… navāpi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:4.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni,
an10.18:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu suvaco hoti sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato khamo padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
an10.18:5.2: suvaco vatāyaṃ bhikkhu sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato khamo padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaninti therāpi naṃ vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi …pe… navāpi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:5.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṅkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso, tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ,
an10.18:6.2: yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho vatāyaṃ bhikkhu analaso tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃkātuṃ alaṃsaṃvidhātunti. therāpi naṃ vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi bhikkhu …pe… navāpi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:6.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro, abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo.
an10.18:7.2: ‘dhammakāmo vatāyaṃ bhikkhu piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo’ti therāpi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi …pe… navāpi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:7.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu ‘āraddhaviriyo vatāyaṃ bhikkhu viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu’ti therāpi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimāpi bhikkhu …pe…
an10.18:8.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītaracīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena
an10.18:9.2: ‘santuṭṭho vatāyaṃ bhikkhu itarītaracīvara piṇḍapātasenāsana gilānapaccaya bhesajjaparikkhārenā’ti therāpi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti, majjhimāpi bhikkhu …pe… vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:9.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
an10.18:10.2: ‘satimā vatāyaṃ bhikkhu paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā’ti therāpi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti. majjhimā pi …pe… navā pi naṃ bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:10.3: tassa therānukampitassa majjhimānukampitassa navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
an10.18:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an10.18:11.2: paññavā vatāyaṃ bhikkhu udayatthagāminiyā ‘paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā’ti therāpi naṃ bhikkhū vattabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti, majjhimā pi bhikkhu …pe… navā pi bhikkhu vattabbaṃ anusāsitabaṃ maññanti.
an10.18:11.3: tassa therānukampitassa- majjhimānukampitassa-navānukampitassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihāni.
